positive_snippets: Neat and clean rooms and bathrooms. budget friendly, good services, helpfull owner and staff

We used to stay here for the purpose of treatment of my mother at RGCI.
We always prefer this hotel because of its close proximity with hospital.
This time in jun we experienced some issues with amenities in washroom, which I hope shall be fixed soon.

Rest all facilities are good ..
We always had a pleasant stay
Thanks
negative_snippets:
We were visiting Delhi for my mother’s treatment at Rajiv Gandhi institute.  A clean environment is essential to her well being, given her immunity is compromised.

We had an absolutely horrible experience! From the time of booking, the owner had a very defensive attitude to even the basic questions asked. Upon arrival, there was no one available for check in. The rooms were in filthy condition and despite the advance notice of our arrival, the room wasn’t set up. We checked out within an hour of checking in. Upon request for a refund or some other consideration, Aashita, the owner, very conveniently blocked me on WhatsApp instead of trying to address any grievances.

Very quick to take money from desperate and vulnerable people, very very poor in providing even the basic services. Absolutely shameful!
